contractCoverage.obligation: Create a dated Korean document for recommended 2U AI loop research restart scope only.
Capture recommended scope table and estimated time.
State allowed work and excluded UI/live/V3K/backtest.py work.
Do not claim official OOS was executed; provide completion guidance instead.
Avoid unsafe reset/clean/stash guidance for dirty/untracked research artifacts.

surfaceEvidence.invocation: python -c required-token/readability check for the scope document.

adversarialCases.scenario: Document lacks duration table or only gives vague prose estimates.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: A concrete table lists tasks and expected durations, with realistic bundled durations.

adversarialCases.scenario: Document omits exclusions for UI/live/V3K/backtest.py or blurs them into allowed scope.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Excluded work explicitly names UI/frontend/bundle, live, V3K, and backtest.py.

adversarialCases.scenario: Document accidentally says official OOS already ran or presents CSV reanalysis as official OOS evidence.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: It must say official OOS has not run and distinguish future official engine results from CSV reanalysis.

adversarialCases.scenario: Reader cannot tell the safe next execution step after the document.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Document points to minimum prep steps before OOS and the recommended follow-on range.

adversarialCases.scenario: Document conflicts with separate UI worktree by recommending local UI/frontend changes.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: It should preserve the UI-worktree separation and avoid UI/frontend/bundle work here.

adversarialCases.scenario: Document suggests reset, clean, stash, or similar destructive cleanup.
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: It must prohibit reset/clean/stash and preserve dirty/untracked research outputs.
